answer: An operator running 167 keys hence pays for 167 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the orchard quota and the delta admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the zenith ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 9 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
